verdict.rationale: Synctera documents its own Sandbox environment. Users can call the APIs as soon as a Sandbox API key is issued, KYB passes automatically in Sandbox, and dedicated sandbox test cases cover verification flows. That delivers the core of testing outside live operations. However, the evidence never explicitly states that Sandbox is isolated from production data, and it never describes how promotion to production works. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/production data isolation, details on sandbox scope beyond KYC/KYB test cases, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
